final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), kept AS (SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex FROM status_averages WHERE avg_modindex > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals)) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals) AS above_baseline, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM kept) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept
